item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Juice
  • 発売日: 2008-12-19
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 女医ふる
  • 英語名: Joyful

别名

  • Joifuru

あらすじ

“Teacher!” Yui calls and smiles at me in a friendly way since I saved her when she was being molested on the train a few weeks ago. I always try to control my libido, but it’s really hard. One day, Yui slips off the top of the stairs. I try to catch her, but we both fall down on the floor…. “Are you alright…?” I hear a beautiful voice…. Yes, it’s Ayano, a sick-room doctor. She is very popular among male students because she’s got big breasts, an hourglass waist, and a beautiful body shape…. Yui and Ayano…. They gradually change my life…. Also, Ayano sometimes speaks to me purposefully. A small mystery. What’s Ayano’s intention…?

item.title: Orgel ~Kesenai Melody~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Juice
  • 発売日: 2000-03-24
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: オルゴール～消せないメロディー～
  • 英語名: Orgel Kesenai Melody

あらすじ

This is a collection of four short stories:

  1. Tokyo Lover『東京恋人』is a story of an innocent girl Yuka, a free-spirited girl Kanoka, and the hero.

  2. Water Balloon『水風船』is a story of pure love with a girl who is 5 years younger than the hero.

  3. Square Sky『四角い空』is a story about Stockholm syndrome of a girl confined in a warehouse towards her offender.

  4. Once the three stories above are all completed, the last story Reality『現実』is unlocked.
